title: create-objectstack: add a `compliance-calendar` template that scaffolds objectstack-ai/duly
body:
Context: objectstack-ai/duly#127 positions Duly (recurring obligation / compliance-calendar app, `objectstack-ai/duly`) as the standard ObjectStack template app. The duly side (template-shaped repo, catalog packs, canary workflow, docs) is tracked there. This is the objectstack side.

## Ask

`create-objectstack` offers a `duly` template (working name `compliance-calendar`) that scaffolds the duly repository at a pinned tag, so `npm create objectstack@latest my-app -- --template compliance-calendar` yields an app that boots empty on `pnpm dev`, has `pnpm demo` for the worked example, and passes its own four gates on the platform version the scaffold pins.

## Measured facts the implementer needs

- duly's four gates (`validate`, `typecheck`, `test` 897 cases, `build`) are green on `@objectstack/*` 17.3.0 (`main` 74342a1, 2026-10-26).
- It depends on `requires: ['automation', 'triggers', 'hierarchy-security']`; the hierarchy capability warns on the open edition by design and must not be silenced by the scaffold.
- It carries its own `AGENTS.md` / `CLAUDE.md` with app-authoring rules (worktree-first, CEL predicates, write-once exception); the scaffold should keep them — they are the template's documentation for the next agent.
- The demo script currently boots twice because of #14157; when that lands the template shrinks to one boot.

## Open points for triage (not for this card to decide)

- Pin strategy: does the scaffold vendor a snapshot of duly at a tag, or fetch it at scaffold time? Snapshot keeps `create-objectstack` self-contained; fetch keeps it current.
- Whether the template ships the demo seed and catalog packs, or only links to them.

Filed by the duly PM seat for objectstack triage; no domain label pre-applied.
